question: A 17-year-old female is brought to the emergency room by her parents shortly after a suicide attempt by aspirin overdose. Which of the following acid/base changes will occur FIRST in this patient?
analysis: Aspirin overdose can lead to metabolic acidosis due to the accumulation of salicylic acid, which is a weak acid. The initial acid/base change that occurs in this patient is likely to be respiratory alkalosis as a compensatory mechanism to try to decrease the acidity in the body by increasing respiratory rate and blowing off carbon dioxide.
